Financial Advisor Associate
Summit Ridge Wealth - Charlotte, NC

Summit Ridge Wealth is a team of 6 advisors serving 900 families. The associate opens accounts,
moves assets in from other firms and answers clients when their advisor is out.

Requirements
- Active FINRA Series 7 and Series 66 registrations
- 2+ years supporting financial advisors
- Opening accounts and processing account transfers

Preferred
- Salesforce or another CRM
- Answering client service calls

Full-time, in office. Bonus tied to client service scores.
